title: Arka Announce
description: A powerful Minecraft plugin for sending customizable screen announcements with Titles, ActionBars, Chat messages, and a dynamic BossBar countdown system.
body:
# Arka Announce

A powerful and flexible Minecraft plugin for creating professional screen announcements using Titles, Subtitles, ActionBars, Chat messages, and a dynamic BossBar countdown system.

---

## ✨ Features

### 🎯 Announcements

* Title & Subtitle support with full timing control
* ActionBar and Chat messages
* Send to individual players or broadcast
* Supports Legacy colors, Hex colors, and MiniMessage
* PlaceholderAPI support

### ⏱️ BossBar Countdown

* Real-time countdown with smooth progress updates
* Multiple color and style options
* Custom time formats (SS, MM:SS, HH:MM:SS)
* Optional sound on completion
* No overlapping bossbars per player

### 🎨 Fully Configurable

* Easy-to-edit config.yml
* Custom colors, styles, and timings
* Toggle MiniMessage and PlaceholderAPI

---

## 📜 Commands

### Base Command

```
/announcement (aliases: /announce, /ann)
```

### Examples

```
/announcement all 5 &cEvent Started! | &7Good Luck!
/announcement bossbar all 60 &cPvP Starts In:
/announcement bossbar stop
/announcement reload
```

---

## 🔐 Permissions

* `screenannouncement.admin` – Full access
* `screenannouncement.send` – Send announcements
* `screenannouncement.bossbar` – BossBar control
* `screenannouncement.reload` – Reload config

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

* Minecraft: 1.21+ (Paper/Spigot)
* Java: 21
* Optional: PlaceholderAPI

---

## 📦 Installation

1. Download the JAR
2. Put it in `/plugins`
3. Restart the server
4. Edit config.yml if needed
5. Use `/announcement reload`

---

## 🧠 Notes

* Optimized for performance (no BossBar recreation)
* Memory-safe player handling
* Clean and lightweight codebase

---
